fields.doc: Unique Timestamp Identifier for this study
fields.name: RUN_DATETIME

fields.doc: Flag to indicate if this Predispatch case includes an intervention pricing run: 0 = case does not include an intervention pricing run, 1 = case does include an intervention pricing run.
fields.name: INTERVENTION

fields.doc: The unique identifier for the interval within this study
fields.name: INTERVAL_DATETIME

fields.doc: Interconnector identifier
fields.name: INTERCONNECTORID

fields.doc: SCADA MW Flow measured at Run start. For periods subsequent to the first period of a PD7DAY run, this value represents the cleared target for the previous period of that PD7DAY run.
fields.name: METEREDMWFLOW

fields.doc: Cleared Interconnector loading level (MW)
fields.name: MWFLOW

fields.doc: Interconnector Losses at cleared flow
fields.name: MWLOSSES

fields.doc: Marginal cost of Interconnector standing data limits (if binding)
fields.name: MARGINALVALUE

fields.doc: Violation of Interconnector standing data limits
fields.name: VIOLATIONDEGREE

fields.doc: Calculated Interconnector limit of exporting energy on the basis of invoked constraints and static interconnector export limit
fields.name: EXPORTLIMIT

fields.doc: Calculated Interconnector limit of importing energy on the basis of invoked constraints and static interconnector import limit. Note unlike the input interconnector import limit this is a directional quantity and should be defined with respect to the interconnector flow.
fields.name: IMPORTLIMIT

fields.doc: Marginal loss factor at the cleared flow
fields.name: MARGINALLOSS

fields.doc: Generic Constraint setting the export limit
fields.name: EXPORTCONSTRAINTID

fields.doc: Generic Constraint setting the import limit
fields.name: IMPORTCONSTRAINTID

fields.doc: Calculated export limit applying to energy + Frequency Controlled Ancillary Services.
fields.name: FCASEXPORTLIMIT

fields.doc: Calculated import limit applying to energy + Frequency Controlled Ancillary Services.
fields.name: FCASIMPORTLIMIT

fields.doc: Aggregate Constraint contribution cost of this Interconnector: Sum(MarginalValue x Factor) for all relevant Constraints, for Export (Factor >= 0)
fields.name: LOCAL_PRICE_ADJUSTMENT_EXPORT

fields.doc: Key for Local_Price_Adjustment_Export: 2 = at least one Outage Constraint; 1 = at least 1 System Normal Constraint (and no Outage Constraint); 0 = No System Normal or Outage Constraints
fields.name: LOCALLY_CONSTRAINED_EXPORT

fields.doc: Aggregate Constraint contribution cost of this Interconnector: Sum(MarginalValue x Factor) for all relevant Constraints, for Import (Factor >= 0)
fields.name: LOCAL_PRICE_ADJUSTMENT_IMPORT

fields.doc: Key for Local_Price_Adjustment_Import: 2 = at least one Outage Constraint; 1 = at least 1 System Normal Constraint (and no Outage Constraint); 0 = No System Normal or Outage Constraints
fields.name: LOCALLY_CONSTRAINED_IMPORT

fields.doc: Last date and time record changed
fields.name: LASTCHANGED
